Home.title: Schedule
Home.heading: Plan choreographies and track availability
Home.intro: Everything your association needs to bring choreographies from the studio to the stage.

choreographies.title: Choreography management
choreographies.description: Organize pieces, choreographers, groups, participants, rehearsals, and performances in one place.

resources.title: Choreography resources
resources.description: Keep videos, music, documents, and other useful materials together with each choreography.

planning.title: Smart rehearsal planning
planning.description: Collect availability, spot conflicts, and build schedules that work for every participant.

calendar.title: Google Calendar synchronization
calendar.description: Sync rehearsals and events with Google Calendar so everyone stays up to date.

Unavailability.title: My unavailability
Unavailability.intro: Mark periods when you are not available. Click a date to mark the whole day, click it again to clear it, or use the calendar to draw, move, and resize blocks.

Scheduling.title: Scheduling
Scheduling.intro: Build an optimized rehearsal weekend: pick pieces, days, and locations, then choose one of the generated calendars. Confirming creates the rehearsals.

Events.title: Events
Events.introAll: All association events, including rehearsals, representations, demonstrations, competitions, and festivals.
Events.introRelevant: Events you created, participate in, or that are linked to your choreographies.
Events.emptyCreate: No events yet. Create your first one.

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.intro: Configure association-wide options, listed locations, and members.

Choreographies.title: Choreographies
Choreographies.intro: By default this list shows choreographies you created, choreograph, or participate in.
